reference_sql:
SELECT order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders,
       SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_order_value_eur
FROM sales
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY order_month
HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) < 315
ORDER BY order_month
alternatives: SELECT order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(net_revenue_eur) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_order_value_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) < 315 * COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) ORDER BY 1

SELECT order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders, SUM(net_revenue_eur) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_order_value_eur FROM sales WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_month HAVING SUM(net_revenue_eur) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) < 315 ORDER BY order_month ASC
